label: Ark Coding Plan Lite
limits: About 1,200 requests per 5 hours, about 9,000 per week, about 18,000 per subscription month (Volcengine articles). 5-hour window counted from first request; weekly resets Monday 00:00; monthly from purchase date.
notes: The official page loads prices dynamically ('价格查询中'); it only states '限时 9.9 元起'. The ¥40/mo list price is secondary. USD is my conversion at about 7.1 CNY/USD. Promo: first two months at 25% of list (¥9.9); a secondary source said until 2026-11-08, but Volcengine's own article says '首两月2.5折优惠截止到2026年9月30日', so it may have ended. The activity page still says '限时 9.9 元起'. Model list as of 2026-10-31: 'Deepseek-V4.1-Flash、GLM-5.3 系列、Doubao-Seed-Evolving、Kimi-K3.1-pro'; Kimi-K3, K2.8-Preview and MiniMax are gone. China region only. Volcengine articles say quota works only in supported coding tools and API use outside them may be treated as abuse.

label: Ark Coding Plan Pro
limits: '5 倍于 Lite 套餐的用量' (official page); about 6,000 per 5 hours, 45,000 per week, 90,000 per month, derived from Lite (the articles say only 5x Lite).
notes: ¥200/mo list (secondary) at about 7.1 CNY/USD; promo ¥49.9 for the first two months.
